rows.grounds: instrumental plural of salila, denoting the medium of ablution
compound adjective qualifying salilaiḥ; sat = good, phala = fruit, upeta = endowed
locative compound indicating containers; ādi implies similar vessels
past participle qualifying salilaiḥ, indicating the waters are situated in the containers

items.question: Which qualities and containers characterize the waters prescribed for ritual ablution?
premises: Ritual ablution employs waters as its prescribed medium.
The prescribed waters are endowed with good fruits.
The prescribed waters are placed in good pots and similar vessels.
items.inference: Proper ritual ablution requires fruit-endowed waters situated in auspicious containers.
uncertainties: The term ādiṣu leaves the full range of additional vessels unspecified.
items.plain_english: The ablution is performed with waters endowed with good fruits, placed in good pots and other such vessels.
